LanguageData.RUT_ShipMemory_Containment_Text: The surprisingly hairy creatures have tied something to the deck that will not stop moving. It is not the first time. When this hull was called Kolyska the old masters kept such things below, chained at four corners on plates of their own grown metal, and drew from them what they needed — the fibre and the current.\n\nThe Utinni has remembered how. Holding platforms, inhibitors, the harvesters and the bioferrite generator can now be built. The beast-metal you take from it burns, and the plate you lay from it holds. Chain it well: the more you draw, the harder it pulls.
